import re, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspaces/semio/semio/js')
text=(root/'sketchpad.test.ts').read_text()
ids=set(re.findall(r'semio\.sketchpad[\w\.-]*', text))
app_ids=set()
for p in (root/'sketchpad').rglob('*.ts*'):
    try:t=p.read_text()
    except:continue
    app_ids.update(re.findall(r'semio\.sketchpad[\w\.-]*', t))
missing=sorted([i for i in ids if i not in app_ids])
print('test ids',len(ids),'app ids',len(app_ids),'missing',len(missing))
for i in missing[:200]:
    print(i)
